svg.title: Federated File Hub v2 — Full Architecture
svg.desc: Full system with Directory Node, replica storage nodes, Oracle VPS standby, LLM service, and client file-serving paths.

g.text: try IPv6 direct to origin node

svg.text: · Upload on dir node → ingest locally → embed → store in vector DB
· Upload on storage node → ingest locally → push vectors to dir node
· LLM (Gemma) only called at query time, not ingestion — shared across all nodes
